regions.title: Streaming preview
regions.summary: Deltas are provisional while the answer arrives.
regions.narration: The text preview helps you follow a response as it streams. A visible preview alone does not establish success. If the stream ends early, it may remain incomplete.

regions.title: Authoritative message
regions.summary: The final agent.message replaces its matching preview.
regions.narration: The authoritative agent message replaces its matching preview instead of being appended again. Compare the message identity and final text so the same answer is not displayed twice.

regions.title: Lifecycle evidence
regions.summary: Running and idle events describe the turn lifecycle.
regions.narration: Lifecycle events tell you when the session is running and when it becomes idle. Read the stop reason as well as the status. Idle with end turn supports normal completion; other reasons can mean a pause.

regions.title: Explicit outcome
regions.summary: Completed, paused, error and incomplete are distinct.
regions.narration: Read the reported outcome independently from the answer text. A partial answer can coexist with an error or an incomplete stream. Requires action and budget reached are not normal successful completion.

regions.title: Execution boundary
regions.summary: Offline evidence is authored. Live evidence needs a real run.
regions.narration: An offline fixture teaches the event contract without calling a model. A live run is separate evidence and can incur charges. A local browser cancel does not by itself prove remote interruption or cleanup.

regions.summary: A local command ID means the host accepted work.

regions.title: Wait while busy
regions.summary: A follow-up waits for completed idle evidence.
regions.narration: If the first message is still running, the next command stays in the host queue. It waits for completed idle evidence before submission. Follow the waiting count instead of assuming two simultaneous provider turns.

regions.title: Provider acceptance
regions.summary: Keep user event IDs separate from command IDs.
regions.narration: A provider accepted user event has its own identity. Keep it distinct from the host command identifier. Correlate the accepted event, later messages and the outcome rather than treating all identifiers as interchangeable.
